ceramicBasinTypes.name: SCHOTT CERAN® Concave Lithium Aluminosilicate Glass-Ceramic
ceramicBasinTypes.description: Industry-standard precision-curved 6mm zero-expansion glass-ceramic bowl with high thermal shock tolerance; vulnerable primarily to deep localized mechanical point-impact fractures.

ceramicBasinTypes.name: EuroKera KeraResist® Concave Wok Glass-Ceramic
ceramicBasinTypes.description: High-grade commercial glass-ceramic with microcrystalline solid-solution structure designed for commercial 3-phase induction frequencies (20-40 kHz).

ceramicBasinTypes.name: Aged & Grit-Scratched Glass-Ceramic Basin (Sub-Critical Surface Microcracks)
ceramicBasinTypes.description: Heavily abraded basin from worn wok contact, metal spatulas, and uncleaned salt/grit granules; microcracks act as stress concentrators causing sudden brittle fracture.

ceramicBasinTypes.name: Generic Pressed Borosilicate Glass Basin (Non-Ceramic Substitution)
ceramicBasinTypes.description: Low-cost non-compliant replacement bowl lacking true crystalline ceramic phase; suffers catastrophic thermal gradient stress fracture during routine cold stock quenching.

ceramicBasinTypes.name: Engineered Ceramic Glass with PEEK/Silicone Perimeter Dampening Ring
ceramicBasinTypes.description: Premium commercial mounting with perimeter elastomeric decoupling gasket that absorbs 65% of mechanical drop shock and eliminates rim stress concentrations.

wokProfiles.name: Traditional Hand-Hammered Carbon Steel Wok (1.6mm Gauge)
wokProfiles.description: Optimal balance of magnetic flux coupling and tossing agility; slight surface dimples create discrete micro-contact points.

wokProfiles.name: Heavy Spun Commercial Carbon Steel Wok (2.5mm Heavy Gauge)
wokProfiles.description: Heavy commercial stir-fry vessel; generates high impact kinetic energy during rapid tossing and downward slamming.

wokProfiles.name: Traditional Chinese Cast Iron Wok (Rough Pitted Base)
wokProfiles.description: Massive thermal mass but extreme hardness and mass; rough contact surface severely abrades ceramic glass.

wokProfiles.name: Nitrided Lightweight Carbon Steel Wok (1.2mm High-Frequency)
wokProfiles.description: Lightweight agile pan with hardened iron nitride surface; prone to high-frequency acoustic chatter and rapid temperature swings.

wokProfiles.name: 3-Ply Magnetic Stainless / Aluminum Core Wok
wokProfiles.description: Slower inductive heating and lower magnetic permeability; creates uneven radial temperature gradients.

coilPowerTiers.name: 5.0 kW Commercial Prep Station (Single/Split Phase 240V)
coilPowerTiers.description: Entry-level commercial induction wok designed for light prep stations, sauce holding, and small batch frying.

coilPowerTiers.name: 15.0 kW High-Volume Line Wok (3-Phase 400V)
coilPowerTiers.description: Standard high-output restaurant line wok; delivers rapid boiling, frying, and authentic Cantonese wok-hei temperatures.

coilPowerTiers.name: 25.0 kW Turbo Stir-Fry Engine (3-Phase 415V/480V)
coilPowerTiers.description: High-velocity industrial stir-fry range; intense electromagnetic force induces audible magnetostriction in carbon steel.

coilPowerTiers.name: 35.0 kW Industrial Jet Wok Induction Range (3-Phase 480V Turbo)
coilPowerTiers.description: Extreme industrial-scale induction burner; generates intense magnetic fields and thermal rise exceeding conventional jet gas burners.

quenchScenarios.name: Ice-Cold Water / Chilled Stock Deglazing (4°C Liquid into 450°C Wok)
quenchScenarios.description: Flash-chilling of the wok bottom creates an acute localized thermal contraction wave transmitted directly to the ceramic glass contact zone.

quenchScenarios.name: Room-Temperature Sauce & Broth Addition (20°C Liquid into 380°C Wok)
quenchScenarios.description: Standard deglazing with room-temperature stock or marinade; produces moderate localized thermal shock.

quenchScenarios.name: Preheated Master Stock (90°C Boiling Liquid into 350°C Wok)
quenchScenarios.description: Controlled culinary technique utilizing hot master stock ladle; dramatically softens thermal shock and reduces basin tensile stress.

quenchScenarios.name: Continuous Dry Wok Searing / Wok-Hei Smoke (No Liquid Quench)
quenchScenarios.description: Continuous unquenched heating creates extreme radial thermal gradients between the glowing wok apex (480°C) and the ambient basin rim (60°C).

tossingImpactStyles.name: Smooth Cradled Rocking (Zero-Lift Continuous Contact)
tossingImpactStyles.description: Wok stays in continuous contact with the bowl, rolling smoothly along the concave curve without shock impacts.

tossingImpactStyles.name: Standard Commercial Tossing (2-3 cm Lifts with Controlled Taps)
tossingImpactStyles.description: Rhythmic Chinese wok tossing; moderate deceleration force upon touchdown distributed across the lower hemisphere.

tossingImpactStyles.name: Aggressive Wok Slamming & Downward Pounding (High-Rush Peak Service)
tossingImpactStyles.description: Violent downward slamming during peak commercial dinner rushes; severe localized Hertzian contact stress on basin apex.

tossingImpactStyles.name: Metallic Chuan / Spatula Edge Impacting Ceramic Basin Rim
tossingImpactStyles.description: Metal wok spatula edge inadvertently strikes the exposed ceramic glass perimeter rim, creating micro-notches and edge chipping.
